evidence: CaCO3 thin films were deposited in a F-120 ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry Ltd., Finland) under nitrogen atmosphere at a pressure of about 5–10 millibars. Nitrogen was used as a carrier and purging gas. The CaCO3 films were deposited using the Ca(thd)2–O3 process.27 Ca(thd)2 (Volatec Oy, Finland) was evaporated from an open source boat at 188 /C14 C and O3 was generated from O2 (99.9999%) with a Wedeco Ozomatic Modular 4 HC Lab ozone generator. The precursors were pulsed into the reaction chamber using inert gas valving. One-second pulses and purges were used for all precursors.
